parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of the scissors consisting of a stainless steel blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the other half of the scissors, also consisting of a stainless steel blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, working in conjunction with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in opposition to the other blade handle set, creating a shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pivot joint, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, enabling rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
